question: Are there any trees or vegetation shown within 10 feet of the transformer pad locations on the landscape plan? If yes, what are the tree/shrub species and distances from the transformer pads?
checklistItemText: Trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment are not identified as utility-compatible species per ECM Appendix F, or trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductors are not utility-compatible
classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for both presence and distance measurements of trees relative to transformer pads; the distance component ('distances from the transformer pads') is the operative part of the compliance check and requires plan-view measurement between features.
